decision_units.goal: Add explicit run-owned external pytest temporary roots for governed verification
planned_actions: Add an explicit optional external pytest temporary root with independent ordinary-path and run-ownership guards.
Append fixed owned basetemp arguments after unchanged Policy validation and preserve execution evidence and finalization context.
Retain existing environment, selectors, budgets, thresholds and default behavior.
Repair only test-side Windows physical I/O and owned Git process-tree timeout cleanup while retaining logical fixture roots, original assertions, command deadlines and production environment.
Reuse only bounded content-keyed pure YAML decoding with independent return values, fresh actual file reads and all unchanged schema, semantic, identity and freshness validation.

Reuse only a session-private pristine initial test repository after the original real builder succeeds at its original target; physically copy independent Git files after current complete input eligibility, preserving cold fallback, partial failure behavior, all original assertions and subsequent real governance.

Change only external_review metadata identity Windows creation-time selection to available st_birthtime_ns, including zero, with legacy attribute-absence st_ctime_ns fallback; retain POSIX ctime and every current identity, double-read, raw-byte and path guard. Supporting tests and documentation are a separate task-free safety maintenance unit, retained in cumulative validation scope.

Qualify only the complete existing Windows mingw64/bin Git endpoint in the session-private test fixture, live-binding both core/wrapper and preserving every source/config/template/attributes/owner/cold/error guard. Safety fixture/test changes are a separate task-free unit. Runtime computed PATH changes honestly; production environment algorithm and Git context/transport are untouched.

Use bounded four-worker consecutive-file batches only for the current qualified owner warm snapshot. Preserve actual DirEntry and DFS errors, drain before recursion/directory metadata and on every abort, retain actual partials without retry, and keep the original serial path before copying for unsupported inputs or known custom bindings. This safety fixture implementation is a separate task-free unit; no production or Policy behavior changes are added.
